meaning:
προσ-πίπτω
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;]
1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mat.7:25.
2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mrk.7:25; with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:11 5:33, Luk.8:28, Act.16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Luk.5:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.
The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
